title: 2022年6月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
paperTitle: 2022年6月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
prompt: 从前有个农夫嫌他种的禾苗长得慢，就到地里把禾苗一株株地拔高了一点。回家后他对家人说："今天可真把我累坏了！但我总算让禾苗一下子长高了。"他儿子到地里去一看，禾苗都已死光了。 现在有些家长急于让孩子成功，往往步那个农夫的后尘，搞得孩子苦不堪言，却不见孩子学业长进。这样的家长是否该对这个问题有所醒悟，让孩子自然成长呢？
reference: Once upon a time, a farmer, thinking that the rice seedlings he had planted were growing too slowly, went into the field and pulled them up one by one to make each a little taller. After returning home, he told his family, "I'm really worn out today, but I have finally made the rice seedlings grow taller all at once!" When his son went to the field, he found that all the rice seedlings had already withered. Nowadays, some parents, eager to see their children succeed, often follow in the farmer's footsteps, causing their children great suffering, yet seeing no progress in their studies. Shouldn't such parents wake up to this problem and let their children grow naturally?
